min_samples.description: Width readings a corridor must accumulate, attributed by heading, before its width estimate is trusted.

plausible_width_margin_m.description: Margin (m) outside the legal [NARROW, WIDE] band within which a reading is a plausibility failure (a corner), not accepted.

max_start_samples.description: Length of the rolling window of stationary width readings kept before the start button, so only readings after placement count.

decision_boundary_m.description: Width (m) at which a raw measurement snaps to WIDE rather than NARROW; defaults to the midpoint of the two legal widths.
